title: S0 intake boundary — run plan / scope sheet (scoping-ba-intake output)
description: Boundary contract for the S0 intake artifact (run-plan). Permissive stage boundary; required mirrors the YAML required_fields. Successful state is ready-for-discovery; unusably thin input fails the stage (no artifact).
